name: mindcheck
description: MindCheck — free, privacy-first mental health screening (PHQ-9, GAD-7, PSS-10, DASS-21)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace client && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
